newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Bancorporation sets stock split [CORRECTED 18:20 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Southwest Bancorporation sets stock split [CORRECTED 18:20 GMT].

text.p: (Corrects name of company from Southwest Bancorp and makes clear it is privately held).
- Southwest Bancorporation said on Wednesday it set a 2.5-for-1 split of its common stock and had registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of common shares.

The company said it expects the offering to consist of 1,150,000 shares to be sold by the company and about 200,000 shares sold by existing shareholders. It estimated the price range at $14 to $16 per share on a post-split basis.
The offering will be managed by Keefe, Bruyette & Woods Inc and Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc.

The net proceeds to the company from the sale of the shares by the company will be used to redeem the outstanding shares of preferred stock of its Southwest Bank of Texas unit and for general corporate purposes.
